proof_rule: No image, GLB, AVAL animation, metadata, mint, sale, or deployment claim is complete until the referenced asset exists and validates.

motion_runtime.name: AVAL
motion_runtime.role: Web-native deterministic animation layer for collectible previews and interactive card states
boundaries: GLB remains the canonical 3D model asset.
AVAL supplies prerendered interactive motion previews, not editable 3D geometry.
Every AVAL player must include host-owned fallback markup.
Unsupported WebCodecs, WebGL, or AVC environments must retain the fallback image.
No .avl asset is marked ready until its source, fallback, integrity value, and validation evidence exist.
